ruleName: Restrictions on Touching Sand in Bunker
title: Accidental Contact with Sand in Bunker during Backswing
question: Your ball is in a bunker. As you start your backswing, your club accidentally brushes the sand before reaching the ball. You did not deliberately test the sand or ground your club before making the stroke. What is the correct ruling?

choices.text: You receive a one-stroke penalty because your club touched the sand.
You receive the general penalty because you touched the sand in a bunker.
There is no penalty because the club only touched the sand during the backswing for the stroke.

explanation: There is no penalty if a player's club brushes the sand in a bunker during the backswing for a stroke, provided the player does not deliberately test the condition of the sand or improve the conditions affecting the stroke. Rule 12.2b allows incidental contact with sand during the backswing, and no penalty is applied in this scenario.
